proposedContract.originalReferenceRule: Flatten repeated reuse to the original completed document check; reject cycles and ambiguous origins. Never renew original source times or scheduling stamps while copying retained validations.
proposedContract.expiredTransportRule: Expired retained transport becomes genuine due freshness-repair work under unchanged collection and fetch bounds. The read-only replay helper cannot secretly fetch or grant stale coverage.

proposedContract.receiptInventoryEquation: current discovery items union anchored prior retained inventory union anchored prior pending items = newly processed document URLs disjoint-union retained replay URLs disjoint-union unresolved pending URLs
proposedContract.freshTransportAfterExpiry: A new real successful fetch or genuine source-specific 304 is required; same body and input/policy/context may reuse historical semantic dispositions. Different body/input/policy/context requires new appropriate validation. Never rewrite original evidence times.
proposedContract.failureBehavior: Keep source not_checked; preserve retained evidence history, preserve all unresolved inventory, do not advance successful source cursor; do not relabel retained missing proof as already done.
proposedContract.modelBudget: Offline replay and valid semantic cache reuse require no model reservation. New extraction/review uses unchanged persistent daily 40-document/80-call limits. No quota increase or current live work.
